records.text: Victor Marx said he traveled to Haiti after an orphanage urgently requested help in response to an imminent threat from the 400 Mawozo gang.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: The reason I'm here in Haiti doing all this high-risk missionary stuff is a while back we responded to the urgent requests of an orphanage that was under imminent threat. ... Of attack by what many consider the most notorious gang in Haiti, the 400 Mawozo. It broke my heart to think of the possibilities were this gang to attack to take control over that area.

verification.notes: The statement is attributional and is supported by public mission coverage: Marx traveled to Haiti, presented the mission as protecting orphanages and vulnerable people amid gang threats, and met leaders associated with Cherizier and 400 Mawozo. The source confirms his public explanation, not every detail of the claimed urgent request.
